audit: 2026-09-07 scheduled remote agent p6: 50 Qs in one batch across all four topics (Paediatrics 11, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 13, Psychiatry 13, Medicine 13), published as ten 5-question files to stay within the tool payload limit that truncated a larger call. Per-question deficit selection was again run on the active L3-L5 tier, because the closed legacy L2 inventory of about 30 per cent per topic makes the whole-topic denominator unreachable and a raw whole-topic greedy degenerates into an all-L3 batch in two topics. Every topic entered the run at 49.1 to 49.2 per cent L3, 44.1 per cent L4 and 6.7 per cent L5, so L5 sat above its 5 per cent target in all four topics and none was generated; L4 was marginally the most deficient cell everywhere, giving 24 L3 and 26 L4 and zero L2. Topic weighting followed the module balance rule rather than the near identical within-topic proportions, so the two lowest count modules took 13 each and the highest count module took 11. Correct-letter distribution A10 B10 C10 D10 E10; worst option length parity max/min 1.35 or better on every question with the correct option the longest in only 8 of 50; zero non-ASCII characters, zero em-dashes and zero banned tokens; every rationale carries an inline source and every source_ref matches a label in that question's sources; no stem or id duplicates against the existing bank; every stem positions the candidate as the treating doctor.
